def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_sep = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_sep = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        out=[]; start=0
        for x in cuts:
            if start < x: out.append((start,x))
            start=x+1
        if start<n: out.append((start,n))
        return out
    rs, cs = spans(h,row_sep), spans(w,col_sep)
    bg = min(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    sep_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in row_sep} | {grid[0][c] for c in col_sep}
    colors = [v for v in set(x for row in grid for x in row) if v != bg and v not in sep_colors]
    marker = max(colors, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    return [[int(sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)) > 1)
             for c0,c1 in cs] for r0,r1 in rs]

def transform(grid):

    colors = [v for v in counts if v not in sep_colors]
